MsgraphAttachment.description:
A message attachment.

Graph models several subtypes (`fileAttachment`, `itemAttachment`,
`referenceAttachment`); this captures the common fields plus the
`fileAttachment` content bytes (base64) when present.

contentBytes.description: The base64-encoded content, for the `fileAttachment` subtype.

contentType.description: The MIME type of the attachment content.

id.description: The unique identifier of the attachment.

isInline.description: Whether the attachment is displayed inline in the body.

lastModifiedDateTime.description: The last modification date, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

name.description: The file name of the attachment.

size.description: The size of the attachment in bytes.

description: Renderable table of Microsoft Graph message attachments.
title: AttachmentsTable
